text: And Job continued to lift up his discourse, and he said,
“Who will make me as [in] months past, as the days [when] God was keeping me?
In His lamp shining upon my head, by His light I walked [through] darkness,
as I was in the days of my harvest time, when the counsel of God was upon my tent,
when yet Shaddai [was] with me, my children around me,
with the washing of my steps with cream, and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
[Or] in my going out [to] the gate upon the town, in the square I established my seat;
the young men saw me and hid themselves, and old men arose [and] stood;
the princes refrained from words, and they put a hand on their mouth;
the voice of the nobles was hidden, and their tongue stuck to their palate.
For the ear heard and declared me blessed, and the eye saw and testified for me,
because I rescued the poor crying out, and the fatherless, and no one was helping him.
The blessing of the one perishing came upon me, and the heart of the widow I caused to sing.
I clothed myself with righteousness, and it clothed me; like a robe and a turban [was] my justice.
I was eyes to the blind, and I [was] feet to the lame.
I [was] a father to the poor, and the case I did not know, I searched it out.
And I broke the fangs of the unjust, and I cast away the prey from his teeth.
So I said, ‘In my nest I will die, I will multiply [my] days as the sand.
My root is open to the waters, and the dew lodges on my branch.
My glory [is] fresh within me, and my bow in my hand is renewed.’
They listened to me and waited, and they kept silent for my counsel.
After my word, they did not speak again, and my speech dripped upon them.
And they waited for me as for the rain, and their mouth they opened wide, as for the spring rain.
I smiled at them, [and] they could not believe [it], and the light of my face they did not let fall.
I chose their path and sat [as] chief, and I dwelt as a king with [his] band, like one who comforts the mourners.
